translation.title: Ciclopirox Nail Lacquer
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for onychomycosis - fungal infection of the fingernails and toenails (nail fungus).
translation.usage: When first using this medicine, remove as much of the affected nail as possible with nail clippers or scissors, and roughen the remaining affected nail with the enclosed nail file or sandpaper. Then apply a thin film to the affected nail: every other day during the first month, at least twice a week during the second month, and once a week from the third month onward. About once a week, remove the whole lacquer film with the enclosed single-use remover and roughen the affected nail again as at the start. If part of the lacquer film peels off in between, it is enough to reapply the lacquer to that part only. The treatment period depends on the severity of the condition, but do not exceed 6 months.
translation.caution: Children must not use this medicine. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant, possibly pregnant or breastfeeding. This medicine is for external use only - apply it carefully so that it does not touch the eyes, nose, mouth or other mucous membranes. Do not use cosmetic nail polish while using this medicine. Adverse reactions such as occasional redness and scaling of the skin around the treated nail may occur; if they do, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light and keep out of reach of children. To keep the solution from drying out, close the cap tightly right after use, and avoid spilling solution around the bottle opening so that the cap does not stick to the bottle.
